{{Top|leg}}
'''Micro-molecular grip-locks''' were [[Lock/Legends|locking mechanisms]] used in the [[EVS BBS-909]] emergency [[Magnetic seal/Legends|vacuum seal]]. They kept the seal in place long enough for the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] micro-organisms to create a solid seal.
